en.t: The Medicine King chapter of the Lotus Sutra says:

units.source_text: “若有人闻是药王菩萨本事品，能随喜赞善者，

en.t: If someone hears this chapter on the former deeds of Medicine King Bodhisattva and is able to rejoice in it and praise it,

units.source_text: 是人现世口中，常出青莲花香。

en.t: then in this present life, the fragrance of blue lotus flowers will constantly come from that person's mouth.

units.source_text: 身毛孔中，常出牛头旃檀之香。”

en.t: And from the pores of their body, the fragrance of ox-head sandalwood will constantly emerge.
